[ffff64]*Proceed to the epilogue of the quest:\n"Leafy Sakura Dog Picture Scroll"?[ffffff]
M-my meat doesn't taste good!\nI haven't had a decent meal for a while!
Hmph, good. That means your meat isn't gamey.
A-and that's not all!\nI haven't been exercising at all lately!
Well, I haven't had fatty meat in a while.
Oh my god, uh, a-and also...
Hmph, relax!\nEating someone like you wouldn't fill me up!
I've got unfinished business with Sandayu.\nSince you're the leader of the Leafy Sakura Clan,\nI can use you to lure him out...
Foolish dog...\nI'm the Ghostfire Oni. You sure you wanna\nchallenge me?
It's the ultimate ninja technique of the\nLeafy Sakura Dog!!\nWall-Run Triangle Crunch!!
Wow, look at him!!\nHe's got a whole new level of respect from me\nnow!!
C'mon, show him what you've got!
Oh! Be careful guys! Especially you, Pelulumaru!
...Hey!\nDon't call me like that! It sounds like a dog's\nname!!
Get behind them and make sure no one escapes!
You morons...\nI'll make sure you learn how terrifying oni can\nbe!
I won't forget your face...I'll annihilate the\nLeafy Sakura and the Black Peach, make you feel\nutterly powerless, and finally cut off your head!
Wait, what?!\nBoss...is letting them off the hook?!
Huh!\nHe was clearly no match for us, yet he was trying\nto look cool~!
Yeah, that Ghostfire Oni was nothing!
How about you?\nYou were caught by that thing, right?
We saw it too~!\nYou were pretty cool, Hayatemaru!
Alright, now that he's pumped up, shall we let him\ntry the Mt. White Peach Shrine challenge again~?
The sun is going down soon, but I think we still\nhave time for at least one run?
No, I'll stop here this time...
We all have things we're good and bad at.\nI feel bad for him. I don't wanna force him to do\nit anymore...
First and foremost, I need to learn more about\nHayatemaru.
Well, I don't mean to force you or anything, but\nnot being able to get a reward kinda sucks~.
I know it was just some kind of adrenaline rush\nbecause Princess Nanaka was in danger, but...
If you can pull off that killer move you used on\nthe Ghostfire Oni again, you could probably get a\nconsolation prize!
Attaboy, I knew you'd be up for it!\nLet's go back to Leafy Sakura Village and start\nthe special training right away~!
...He probably just thinks you're playing with\nhim.
